body: Real root cause of the missing draft screen: auto_deploy.sh's publish loop copied red_garden_arena_server/_bot/matchmaker on every green CI build but never red_garden_arena (the human SDL2 client), so the client silently drifted hours/dozens of commits behind the live server (including missing the Zagan 28th-hero wire-protocol-affecting change). Added client to the publish loop, rebuilt everything from current main, restarted the live matchmaker/bot-pool trio, confirmed clean steady-state queue.
title: fix: auto_deploy.sh never republished the human arena client binary
